description:
WebForms Core Java implementation by Elanat.
		A modern server-driven UI technology based on Commander–Executor pattern.
		WebForms Core technology is available for all popular programming languages on the web.
		To use this technology, you must install the WebFormsJS JavaScript library and insert it
		into the head section of the HTML page.

		WebFormsJS Installation:

		Installation via Package:
		npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/webformsjs
		CLI: npm install webformsjs

		Download / Copy the File:
		WebFormsJS on Elanat: https://elanat.net/webforms-js
		WebFormsJS on GitHub: https://github.com/webforms-core/WebFormsJS
